A simple value object representing a cache expiration entry, storing a Unix timestamp to indicate when a cached resource becomes stale.

## Key Components

- **`timestamp`** (`long`) — Unix epoch timestamp (milliseconds) marking the expiration point of a cached resource.
- **`@Data`** — Lombok annotation generating getters, setters, `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString`.
- **`@Builder`** — Lombok annotation providing a fluent builder API for constructing instances.

## Usage Example

```java
Expiration expiration = Expiration.builder()
    .timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis() + Duration.ofHours(1).toMillis())
    .build();

boolean isExpired = System.currentTimeMillis() > expiration.getTimestamp();
```
